AGO.note: Law 7/26 (in force 2026-08-19) creates a beneficial-owner register, CRBE, separate from the commercial registries, with first filings due by 2027-02-15; not the business register holding owners in service.

facts.fact: A law-firm note on Law 7/26 of 19 August 2026 says personal data in the beneficial-owner register is processed automatically under the Personal Data Protection Law, treating that law as applying.

AGO.note: Entities are keyed on a Tax Identification Number; no register is said to use the national ID number.
No consultation on the law is stated.
Mentions a Tax Identification Number only as a scope test; no taxpayer register state is given.
